name: Adani Enterprises Ltd
description: Adani Enterprises Ltd (ADANIENT) is a leading Indian infrastructure and building materials enterprise specializing in the manufacture of grey cement, ready-mix concrete (RMC), clinker, and building solutions. company_profile.summary: Adani Enterprises Ltd (ADANIENT) is a leading Indian infrastructure and building materials enterprise specializing in the manufacture of grey cement, ready-mix concrete (RMC), clinker, and building solutions. Leveraging energy-efficient manufacturing kilns, waste heat recovery systems, and captive logistics, the enterprise supplies critical materials to national highway corridors, industrial plants, and residential projects.

revenue_breakup.desc: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC), Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC), and bulk construction cement.
Commercial and high-strength concrete delivered directly to infrastructure work-sites.
Wall putty, tile adhesives, waterproofing compounds, and autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) blocks.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% across core northern, western, eastern, or southern operating clusters
moats_and_strengths: High regional freight barriers creating local pricing and supply moats within a 350-400 km radius of plants.
Captive limestone mining leases providing raw material security for decades of production.
Extensive dealer and sub-dealer retail network reaching building contractors and individual home builders.
High adoption of Waste Heat Recovery Systems (WHRS) and alternate fuels lowering power & fuel costs.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Installed Cement Capacity: 30+ MTPA • Captive Power & WHRS generating ~40% of power needs

bullish_triggers: Government infrastructure mega-allocations for expressways, dedicated freight corridors, and airports.
Revival in urban residential real estate construction and rural housing demand.
bearish_risks: Surges in thermal coal and petcoke fuel prices increasing kiln power and energy costs.
Periodic regional cement price wars and monsoon-related construction lulls.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
